question: Take a huge social network and compare people with their friends. On average, how does the number of friends YOU have compare with the number of friends your friends have?
choices: Your friends have more friends than you do, on average
You and your friends have about the same number of friends
Your friends have fewer friends than you do, on average
There is no consistent pattern either way
anchorText: an individual's friends have more friends than that individual
